strings.name: Liu Jiakun
strings.summary: Born in Chengdu and trained in Chongqing, Liu worked at a state design institute while also writing literature. He returned to architectural practice in the 1990s and established Jiakun Architects in 1999. His team starts from local materials, low-tech strategies and everyday life. From Luyeyuan Stone Sculpture Art Museum and Hu Huishan Memorial to Chengdu's West Village, they organize remembrance, community and public activity within architecture. Awarded the 2025 Pritzker Prize, his practice continues to emphasize shared space in dense cities.
